cli.description: Goslide is a blazing-fast, single-binary Markdown presentation deck builder.
cli.long:
Goslide 📽️ - A blazing-fast, single-binary Markdown presentation deck builder in Pure Go.

Instantly convert Markdown documents into self-contained interactive web slides (HTML),
16:9 borderless vector PDFs, and presenter-note-preserving PowerPoint (PPTX) presentations
with zero CGO or external runtime dependencies.

Features a built-in screencast drawing canvas (D/C keys), dual-screen presenter console (P key),
digital laser pointer (L key), and spotlight focus (S key) optimized for tutorials and talks.
cli.example:
# 1. Unpack demo presentation and themes playground
  goslide demo

  # 2. Start live preview server with SSE hot reload and auto-open browser
  goslide serve demo.md --open

  # 3. Build to HTML, vector PDF, and PowerPoint PPTX
  goslide build demo.md -f all -o dist/

  # 4. Create your own presentation slide
  goslide init my-slide.md

  # 5. Print AI system prompt for ChatGPT / Claude
  goslide prompt

  # 6. List built-in themes and export CSS
  goslide theme list
cli.lang.flag: Set language for CLI and presentation UI (auto, en, ko)
cli.build.desc: Build presentation slides (HTML/PDF/PPTX) from Markdown source
cli.build.long:
Parses a Markdown source file (.md) and compiles it into an interactive web slide deck (HTML), 16:9 vector PDF, or PowerPoint (PPTX).

Fully supports Frontmatter metadata, 5 semantic layouts (cover, section, two-cols, blank, default),
native Chroma syntax highlighting, KaTeX math formulas, and GFM tables. Use -f pdf to generate a vector PDF, or -f pptx to export PowerPoint with speaker notes, or
use --standalone to inline all local image assets into a self-contained, single-file HTML bundle.
cli.build.example:
# Default build (outputs: presentation.html)
  goslide build presentation.md

  # Export 16:9 borderless vector PDF
  goslide build presentation.md -f pdf -o dist/talk.pdf

  # Export 16:9 PowerPoint (PPTX) with speaker notes
  goslide build presentation.md -f pptx -o dist/talk.pptx

  # Specify output path and bundle as standalone HTML
  goslide build presentation.md -o dist/index.html --standalone

  # Override theme (default, clean, dark)
  goslide build talk.md --theme clean

  # Apply custom external CSS stylesheet
  goslide build talk.md --theme-path ./custom.css
cli.build.flag.format: Output format: html, pdf, pptx, or all (comma-separated; default: html)
cli.build.flag.theme: Theme name (default, clean, dark; overrides frontmatter)
cli.build.flag.theme_path: Path to custom external CSS stylesheet
cli.build.flag.standalone: Inline local image assets as Base64 Data URIs into a self-contained bundle
cli.init.desc: Create a new starter presentation Markdown file
cli.init.long: Initializes a rich sample presentation Markdown file (.md) showcasing Goslide features (layouts, code highlighting, math, mermaid diagrams, incremental fragments, and presenter notes).
cli.init.example:
# Create default presentation.md with clean theme
  goslide init

  # Create presentation with specific filename and dark theme
  goslide init talk.md --theme dark

  # Overwrite existing file
  goslide init presentation.md --force

   • Demo Presentation: ./%s/demo.md (14-slide showcase presentation & images)
   • Project Themes: ./%s/ (clean.css, dark.css, academic.css)

🚀 Try Goslide with the following quick steps:

1. Launch live preview:
   $ goslide serve %s/demo.md
   (Browser will automatically open and presentation mode begins)

2. Experience hot live reload:
   • Open %s/demo.md in your editor, modify content, and save.
   • The browser updates instantly without flickering!

3. Change themes:
   • Change theme: "clean" at the top of %s/demo.md to "dark" or "academic".
   • Or edit CSS files in the %s/ folder to craft your own style.

4. Convert to multiple formats (HTML, PDF, PPTX):
   $ goslide build %s/demo.md -f html,pdf,pptx
   (Generates web slides, vector PDF, and PowerPoint PPTX in one go)

5. Create your own new slide:
   $ goslide init my-slide.md

💡 See 'goslide --help' for commands, or refer to 'QUICKSTART.md' for the full guide.

cli.serve.desc: Start local development server with live reload
cli.serve.long:
Starts an ultra-fast local development server that watches the Markdown file for changes
and automatically refreshes the browser with live hot reload.

Powered by standard Server-Sent Events (SSE), updates render in under 300ms while preserving
your active slide position via URL hash sync.
cli.serve.example:
# Start default development server (http://localhost:8080)
  goslide serve presentation.md

  # Change port and automatically open default browser
  goslide serve presentation.md --port 3000 --open

  # Allow remote access (bind to 0.0.0.0)
  goslide serve talk.md --bind 0.0.0.0 -p 8080

  # Preview with dark theme and custom CSS
  goslide serve talk.md -t dark --theme-path ./custom.css
cli.serve.flag.bind: Network interface address to bind to
cli.serve.flag.open: Open presentation in default browser on start
cli.serve.flag.theme: Theme name (default, clean, dark; overrides frontmatter)
cli.serve.flag.theme_path: Path to custom external CSS stylesheet
cli.serve.flag.debounce: File watch debounce interval (filters duplicate write events)
